Chris walked into the gym with the swagger of a man who had just watched one too many superhero movies, convinced that the new weight machine was about to meet its match. He approached the contraption with the confidence of a seasoned pro, slamming his body into the seat and gripping the handles like he was trying to strangle a bear. But instead of lifting the weight, he found himself in an awkward, involuntary hug with the machine. The more he struggled, the tighter the machine seemed to hold him, turning his display of strength into a desperate search for a release button that looked suspiciously like a decorative rivet. Nearby gym-goers couldn’t help but burst into laughter as they watched this epic battle of man versus machine, with the machine clearly winning the round. It was a humbling reminder that sometimes, the only thing stronger than your ego is a poorly designed lever.

The shape with three sides is a triangle.
